sentences.en: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10, 000 feet.

sentences.en: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.
sentences.zh: 伯德立刻命令手下扔掉两个沉重的食物袋。

sentences.en: The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
sentences.zh: 飞机因此得以升高，以400英尺的高度越过了山头。

sentences.en: Byrd now knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away,
sentences.zh: 伯德这时知道，他能够到达300英里外的南极，

sentences.en: for there were no more mountains in sight.
The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.
sentences.zh: 飞机顺利地飞越了无边无际的白色平原。
